blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
A trial balance is a simple check. At the end of a period, you list every account and its total. Then you add up all the debits and all the credits. If they are equal, the books are balanced. If they are not, something is wrong and you must find it.

A balanced trial balance does not mean everything is correct. It only means the numbers add up. But it is a fast way to catch simple mistakes before they grow into bigger ones.

Accountants run a trial balance every month, and sometimes every week. Small errors found early are almost always easy to fix.

items.q: What do you do first in a trial balance?
options: You list every account and its total
items.why: "you list every account and its total" — esse é o primeiro passo.

items.q: When are the books balanced?
options: When the debits are bigger than the credits
When the debits and the credits are equal
items.why: "If they are equal, the books are balanced."

items.q: The text suggests that a balanced trial balance…
options: means the company made a profit
does not prove every number is correct
items.why: Inferência: "does not mean everything is correct" — só mostra que os números fecham.

items.q: Why do accountants run the trial balance often?
options: Because small errors found early are easy to fix
items.why: "Small errors found early are almost always easy to fix."

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: it is better to find small errors late
it is better to find small errors early
trial balances are a waste of time
you should only check once a year
items.why: Inferência: o texto valoriza rodar o balancete com frequência para pegar erros cedo.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Emily rodando o balancete de fevereiro. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Okay, it is Friday afternoon, and I am running the trial balance for February. I do this at the end of every month. It is a quick check, but it is important.

So, I list every account. Then I add up all the debits, and I add up all the credits. Right now the two totals are not equal. There is a difference of two hundred and forty pounds. That is not good. Something is wrong.

I am looking for the mistake now. I am checking each entry, one by one. And here it is — one entry has the wrong code. Someone put it in the wrong account. That is the two hundred and forty pounds.

It is a small error, and I am fixing it now. This is why I run the trial balance every month. When you catch a mistake early, it is easy to fix. If you wait, it grows. Okay, the numbers are equal again. The books are balanced. Good.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What is Emily doing?
options: She is running the trial balance for February
items.why: "I am running the trial balance for February."

items.q: How often does Emily do this check?
options: At the end of every month
items.why: "I do this at the end of every month."

items.q: What is the difference between the two totals?
items.why: "There is a difference of two hundred and forty pounds."

items.q: What caused the mistake?
options: One entry has the wrong code
items.why: "one entry has the wrong code. Someone put it in the wrong account."

items.q: Emily suggests that catching a mistake early is…
items.why: Inferência: "When you catch a mistake early, it is easy to fix. If you wait, it grows."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "I run the trial balance at the end of the month." A trial balance is…
options: a check that the debits and credits are equal
items.why: Trial balance = balancete: a checagem de que débitos e créditos batem.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "On the left side we write the ___, and on the right side we write the credits."
items.why: Debit = débito, o par de credit (crédito).

items.q: "The two totals are equal, so the books are balanced." Balanced means…
items.why: Balanced = equilibrado: os dois lados são iguais.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I want to ___ the mistake before it grows into a big problem."
items.why: To catch = pegar / flagrar o erro.

items.q: "It is a small error, so it is easy to fix." To fix means to…
items.why: To fix = corrigir.

blocks.instruction: Expressões que aparecem em reuniões de contabilidade. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Can you add up all the debits?" To add up means to…
options: put numbers together to find the total
items.why: Add up = somar, juntar os números para achar o total.

items.q: "The manager has to sign off on the report." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar, dar o aval.

items.q: "I need to look for the mistake." To look for means to…
items.why: Look for = procurar, tentar encontrar.

items.q: "Small errors can grow into big problems." To grow into means to…
items.why: Grow into = crescer até virar, tornar-se.

items.q: "Let's go through each entry one by one." To go through means to…
items.why: Go through = revisar, examinar item por item.
